meta.name: fixture-web-form-validation
meta.description: Fill the release name, run validation, and assert the result region flips to PASS (reproduces the 2026-08-25 acceptance web flow).
notes: Served from the shipped fixtures/web/ directory (package.json files includes fixtures/web).

target.launch is an example default (port 7399); scripts/run-example.mjs rebinds it to an ephemeral loopback port via ReplayRunOptions.launchUrl, so the example works on a normal install without a hardcoded port.

steps.intent: Fill the Release name input with a version string.
